notes.title: Austeja Season Preview
notes.content:
[h3][b]Saviors, a new season awaits![/b][/h3][p]The [b]"Austeja" Season[/b] is coming to Tree of Savior this September! Discover new realms, master powerful equipment, and embrace the mystical [b]Hermit[/b] class as Austeja's blessing transforms the world around you.[/p][p]With the level cap raised to 540 and exciting new content to explore, your greatest adventures are just beginning.[/p][h3][b]Here's what's coming in the Austeja Season:
[/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/51064c78a0d3d251ab5312816e54cad26bc34fbc.png"][/img]
We hope to see you next week, Saviors![/h3]

notes.title: Zachariel Server Merge: Future Changes to Dormant Team Status
notes.content:
[p]Greetings, Saviors![/p][p][/p][p]In this posting, we would like to announce the details about the [b]future status changes regarding the dormant teams [/b]in the[b] NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute.[/b][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Target Criteria[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Dormant Target Server:[/b] [b]NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute[/b] [/p][p][b]Dormant Target Team:[/b] Teams that do not meet any of the following criteria below. [/p][p][/p][p][b]▶ Accounts that have[/b]: [/p][p]- Record of entering the game within 1 year before the Zachariel Server Merge (July 15, 2025).[/p][p]- Purchased Premium TP[/p][p]- Used Premium TP[/p][p]- Possessed Premium TP 
[/p][p][b]※ Accounts that only purchased Steam DLCs will be changed to Dormant Status. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]※ If you have a team for multiple servers in a single account, [u]the team must meet the criteria above to stay active[/u].[/p][p][b]EXAMPLE[/b]: (If you have teams on [b]all three servers,[/b] and only the teams on [b]EU Fedimian and SA Silute[/b] have [b]purchased TP and logged into the game[/b], while the team on [b]NA Klaipeda has not met any of the criteria, [/b]the team on [b]NA Klaipeda [/b]will be [b]set to dormant[/b]. Between the [b]EU Fedimian and SA Silute servers[/b], the dormant team will be determined according to the [b][url="https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=3386"]Global Merge Policy: When you have teams on more than one server[/url][/b].)[/p][p][/p][p]※ When the Team set to Dormant Status, the [b]Team will be deleted. [/b][/p][p][/p][p]※ If you want to restore your Dormant Account, you must[b] send a ticket [/b]during the[b] restoration period. (August 12, 2025)[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Details[/h2][p][/p][p]1. When a team is switched to dormant status, the [b]existing team will be removed[/b] and the UI for creating a new team will pop up upon entering the barrack.[/p][p][/p][p]2. If you wish to remove the dormant status from your team, you can[b] send us a ticket before August 12, 2025[/b].[/p][p]  - This request is[b] only [/b]accepted when [b]sent by the owner of the account[/b].[/p][p]  - The request is applied during the scheduled maintenance every week during the restoration period.[/p][p]  ※ If you already made a new team before requesting to remove the dormant status from the original team, this new team will be deleted. [/p][p][/p][p][b]3. All dormant teams cannot be recovered after the restoration period (August 12, 2025). [/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your support and interest in Tree of Savior.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Regards,[/p][p]IMC Staffs.[/p]

notes.title: Preview: Tree of Savior Zachariel Release and Integration of Region
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/b2b0588317b3671e1cca98ab778b98a37dd12f9e.png"][/img][/p][p]Greetings, Saviors.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]To bring new encounters and expanded adventures to Tree of Savior, the current servers: [b]NA[/b] Klaipeda, [b]EU[/b] Fedimian, and [b]SA[/b] Silute will be [b]merged into a single server[/b] named ‘[b]Zachariel[/b]’ on [b]Tuesday, July 15, 2025 (KST).[/b][/p][p][/p][p]The new [b]Zachariel [/b]server will unite Saviors from various regions, forming a diverse community that transcends language and culture. We believe this significant change will inject vitality into the game, fostering more dynamic strategies and collaboration in an enriched gameplay environment.[/p][p][/p][p]Saviors from your favorite guilds and regions will be able to find new goals to work towards, while those who aren't tied to a guild or region will be able to create their own unique groupings.[/p][p][/p][p][b]No new installations or changes are required to access Zachariel Server[/b]. Simply launch the Tree of Savior client through Steam as usual, and you will automatically connect to the merged server.[/p][p][/p][p][b]⚠️I[u]n the meanwhile, SA Silute TP Product Sales will be restricted due to this Server Merge[/u]⚠️ [/b][/p][p]
TP product sales in the SA server will be temporarily restricted starting from the date of this announcement. This is due to price standardization to align with NA/EU server pricing.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/e9da67cc957c47d01f4acb21366bbe80fb40df74.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of [b]Zachariel[/b], we have prepared a variety of exciting events for all Saviors.[/p][p]In particular,[b] special rewards[/b] will be awarded for the [b]first Guild Territory War[/b] after the integration.[/p][p][/p][p]The first[b] Guild Territory Wars (GTW)[/b] held in the [b]Zachariel[/b] server will offer special rewards. Guilds that occupy the Champion League regions —  'Genar Field', 'Aqueduct Bridge Area', and 'Baron Allerno'— will receive a commemorative guild flag engraved with a text and image of the guild’s choice. [/p][p]Additionally, amazing login rewards will be distributed to all players who log into the [b]Zachariel [/b]server within the first[b] 7 days [/b]after the merge.[/p][p]
             [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/1360aa9a9ac015adf9539495a7629c00671584a1.png"][/img]                 [/p][p]We’ve also prepared refreshing[b] summer events[/b] and [b]adorable new mounts[/b] to accompany your journey. We look forward to seeing your exciting adventures unfold in the new [b]Zachariel [/b]server.[/p][p][/p][p]※ The details of the event will be notified in the future announcement.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Zachariel [/b]integrations are guided by the following policies:[/p][p][/p][h2]Tree of Savior Global Merge Policy[/h2][p][/p][p] -  Date: Scheduled maintenance on [b]July 15, 2025 [/b][/p][p] -  Target: [b]NA Klaipeda, EU Fedimian, and SA Silute[/b][/p][p] -  Server Name: [b]North America Zachariel[/b][/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=","][tr][td][p][b]Category[/b][/p][/td][td][p][b]Major Integration Policies[/b][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you only have a team on 1 server[/p][/td][td][p] # The team is transferred without changes except for the reset categories[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]If you have teams on more than one server[/p][/td][td][p][b] # Only the information from one team, selected based on the criteria below, will be transferred, and no other team's information will be transferred. (The following criteria will be applied to determine which teams are transferred)[/b]
  1. Team with more premium TPs
  2. Team with higher team levels (experience)
  3. Team with more characters created
  4. Team with later team creation dates

[b] # Premium TPs are transferred to the final team after all teams' information is summed.[/b]
 - They are also transferred if they were converted to points using TP-packaged items.

[b] # For further activation of teams not selected by the above criteria, you will need to apply by creating a new STEAM account.[/b]
 - The details of the procedure will be announced in a separate announcement in the future.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Guild [/p][/td][td][p] [b]# General Guild[/b]
 - If the Guild Master's team is transferred, the guild will also be transferred and any guild members not transferred will be removed from the guild.
 - If the Guild Master's team is not transferred, the guild will be disbanded and the guild members will be changed to a guildless status.
 - If there are two guilds with the same guild name, the later created guild will be renamed to "Guildname_1" and will receive a “Guild Name Change Voucher”.

[b] # TOS Support Guild[/b]
 - If your team is a member of a TOS Support Guild, it will be transferred to the TOS Support Guild on the [b]\[NA] Klaipeda[/b] server.
 - The Guild Master/general guild member's rank and privileges are retained.

[b] # Not in a guild[/b]

notes.title: Invite Your Friends Event
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

The fruit leaves behind seeds, which in turn grows into a fruit, and the cycle continues! Invite your Friends to Tree of Savior and receive the rewards!

[h2]Event Period[/h2]

[b]From[/b]: After the scheduled maintenance on April 15, 2025 (KST)
[b]To[/b]: Before the scheduled maintenance on May 27, 2025 (KST)

[h3][b]Step 1.[/b] Check if you are a Fruit or a Seed![/h3]

- Click the envelop icon below the Popo Boost icon to participate in the Invite Your Friends event. Both icons can be found on the top right corner, to the lower left of the minimap.

- By clicking the Issue/Retrieve Invite Code, you can check whether you are a Fruit or a Seed, and enter the Invite Code!

▶ Fruit (Referrer/Inviter)

- You can share the Invite Code to a Seed.

- One code can invite a single Seed and can not be reused.

- In order to check your Invite Code, you[b] must have at least one character[/b] that have reached [b]maximum character level of 530.[/b]

▶ Seed (Referee/Invitee)

- Seeds are Saviors without a log-in record before March 16, 2025 (KST)

- You can enter the Invite Code shared from the Fruit and clear the Invite Your Friends event missions.

- You can only enter a single code and once entered, it cannot be edited or changed.

[h3][b]Step 2.[/b] Complete the Invite Your Friends mission and receive the reward![/h3]

- By clicking the Check Invite Your Friends Mission/Receive Rewards or by entering /invite command, you can check the event status. 

- Only the Seed can click the [Receive Rewards] button, but the reward will be given to both the Fruit and the Seed once clicked.

- The Reward will be given to the following locations:

▶ Fruit: Mailbox (please make sure to claim it before June 11, 2025.) 

▶ Seed: Inventory

[h2]Important Note[/h2]

[list]
[*]The UI and the icon of this event will become unavailable after the scheduled maintenance on May 27, 2024 (KST).
[*]A code can invite [b]a single Seed[/b], and the code [b]cannot be reused.[/b]
[*]You can only enter a single code and once entered, [b]it cannot be changed.[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Cherry Blossom Festival Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/640088c9f36c781f67fcb67176006f68fa30c68c.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Saviors!

A warm breeze carries the sweet scent of cherry blossoms! Celebrate spring’s beauty at the Cherry Blossom Festival!

[h2]Event Period[/h2]

[b]After[/b] the regular scheduled maintence on March 11, 2025
[b]TO[/b] April 15, 2025 (KST), before the regular scheduled maintenance

[h2]How to Participate[/h2]

[h3]Step 1.[/h3] [b][Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC[/b] will be available during the event period.
- The NPCs are present at [b][Klaipeda][/b], [b][Orsha][/b], and [b][Fedimian][/b].
- Their specific locations are marked as a red dot in the image below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/4fcadfbffbfc2f7647c6143dabe5d43903997599.png[/img]

[h3]Step 2.[/h3] Clear [b]Challenge/Raid contents and/or defeat field monsters[/b] to receive [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coin[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/4eae4a08ffb9ce2f97b7ccc92e5a6a3df224f09c.png[/img]

* Only monsters with [b]level difference of 50 or less[/b] will drop [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b].

- Example 1: If your character is level 530, only monsters of level 480 or above will have 5% chance of dropping [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b].
- Example 2: If your character is level 480, only monsters in the level range of 430 ~ 530 will have 5% chance of dropping [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b].

[h3]Step 3.[/h3] Exchange the [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b] for various rewards from the Event Shop!
※ You can type "/event" without the quotations to check your current coin status (e.g. weekly limit, total limit, and vice versa)

- Head to the [b][Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC[/b] that can be found in each town and talk to the NPC to exchange the [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b] with the items below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/18214932/a8788c8c1b0c7c298ad04a27863e45d4682fd8e7.png[/img]

* [b]Pink Cherry Blossom[/b] item details:
- Item lasts for 1 Day.

Grants a buff on use:
- Final DMG +3%, Restores 150 HP/SP every 2 sec, MSPD +4
- The buff lasts for 24 hours.

[h3]Disclaimer[/h3]

- Up to 600 [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b] can be obtained per week, per team.
- Up to 3,000 [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b] can be obtained in total, during the event period.
- The weekly limit of [b][Event] TOS Platinum Coins[/b] resets on each [b]Monday, 6 AM[/b] (server time).
- [b][Event] Cherry Blossom Festival NPC[/b] will be available until April 15, 2025, before the maintenance.

notes.content:

notes.content:
Greetings Savior,

On Wednesday, April 26, several patches went live to fix the game.
Please note that this was applied to the game immediately, without the need for a separate patch download.


[KST 17:45]

- Fixed the issue that the clear record of the Wailing Graveyard is not recorded normally
- Current ranking of the Wailing Graveyard is reset


[KST 18:36] - W Server Only

- The spawn location of the Follower monsters in the System messages is only written in Korean.


Thank you.

notes.title: Translation Contribution Update
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors

As some of you may know, we have been receiving contributions from our players for proofreading and translating the game into languages other than English for some time. We currently have Github project pages set up for the English and Portuguese translation of the game and also have recently set up a new project page for the German translation of Tree of Savior.

If you are interested, you can enquire our staff at our Official TOS Translation Discord over at https://discord.gg/zVzQtQ 5 and also browse through our Github project pages for the three languages currently available provided below:

English
 GitHub

Treeofsavior/EnglishTranslation
Tree of Savior Korean to English Translation OTC. Contribute to Treeofsavior/EnglishTranslation development by creating an account on GitHub.


Portuguese
 GitHub

Treeofsavior/PortugueseTranslation
Tree of Savior Brazilian Portuguese Translation OTC - Treeofsavior/PortugueseTranslation


German
 GitHub

Treeofsavior/GermanTranslation
Tree of Savior German Translation OTC. Contribute to Treeofsavior/GermanTranslation development by creating an account on GitHub.

And also visit the Translation page 4 on our official website for a detailed guide on becoming a contributor!

Thank you very much for your continued support.

With love,
IMC Staff

notes.title: [COMPLETE] Temporary Maintenance Notice - Feb 20, 2019
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We will shortly begin a period of temporary maintenance across all servers in order to correct the following issues:

1) Players being unable to craft items or enhance gems/cards.
2) V key not working for quest items.
3) Discrepancies in the Wake Up Enhancement Package (see link here for updated announcement).
4) Potion recipes appearing as finished potions in the Wake Up All-in-One Package.
5) Popo Points not increasing with TP spent ([u]players who already spent TP will be compensated with the corresponding PP during the maintenance[/u]).

Maintenance is expected to take place on the following schedule:

[b][EDT] 01:30 - 03:30
[BRT] 03:30 - 05:30
[CET] 07:30 - 09:30
[SGT] 14:30 - 16:30[/b]

We will update this announcement once maintenance is complete. Thank you for your patience.

notes.title: On Recent Popo Point Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We have confirmed today that the recently-introduced Popo Points ([url=https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=1480]announcement here[/url]) were incorrectly reset a few hours earlier than expected, causing some players to miss out on purchasing their desired items from the Popo Point Shop.

If you were saving PP for an item and lost your points due to this issue, you may submit a ticket through our Support page and let us know which item you had intended to purchase from the Popo Point Shop. You may submit your ticket until EDT 23:59 of October 7, 2018 (tickets submitted after this date will not be processed).

We will check the records on your account to determine whether your Popo Points would have reached the desired total in the hours that followed the early reset and, if sufficient, we will send you the item via GM Message.

Keep in mind, however, that we will carry out this procedure only for items worth more than 100 PP. Depending on the number of submitted tickets, we will process your request within the next few days.

Besides the early PP reset issue, we have also confirmed that, after the reset on October 1, Popo Points have not been correctly accumulating. We are currently investigating the source of the problem and we intend to compensate players for these inconsistencies when the Popo Point Shop reopens.

Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Notice on Russia Connection Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

Due to recent regional IP restrictions and related measures, players located in Russia have reported experiencing connection issues when attempting to access TOS from their region.

If you play Tree of Savior from Russia, you may be unable to access your server and/or certain maps in the game. As this is a situation we are unable to control, we would like to advise players affected by this issue to contact their internet service provider for a possible solution.

Meanwhile, you may also use a trustworthy VPN service to circumvent the IP restrictions. Our apologies for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Known Issues: May 17, 2018
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

The following issues have been recently reported:

[b]1) Earth Tower Instability[/b]

- Several players have reported crash and disconnection issues throughout Earth Tower.

We are currently looking into the source of this issue and we will update this announcement once we obtain more details about the errors reported. If you are encountering this issue, kindly report it through a Support ticket along with the following information:

1) Did the crash/disconnection happen only to you or to all party members at the same time?
2) At what time and where did the issue happen?
3) Your location, PC specifications, internet connection and other details you may be able to provide.
4) Your lastreplay file (Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/replay/lastreplay).

Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Client Performance Optimization Patch
notes.content:
Hello Saviors! 

During the weekly maintenance of April 10, 2018, we took steps to improve TOS' gameplay experience throughout the servers. Specifically, we implemented a client performance optimization patch in order to reduce lag issues and improve frame update processing times. We also moved the [SA] server to a different provider, expanded server capacity and upgraded server performance to address stability issues. 

We hope that these updates are to your liking and please feel free to leave a comment below about your experiences after the maintenance of April 10, 2018!

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Vaivora’s Team Challenge Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!
 
After our scheduled maintenance of March 27, 2018, players reported the following issues: 
 
1. Players on [NA]/[SEA] servers being unable to open the Vaivora’s Team Challenge event shop to exchange their Vaivora Tokens. 

2. Players logging in and finding that the Night Market Event Debuff was still applied. 

We would like to announce that these problems have now been hotfixed. 
 
IMPORTANT: You will need to restart your game client in order for the hotfix to be applied. For players being affected by the Night Market Debuff, after restarting your client you must click the Event Notice Board for the buff to be removed. 

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience while the issue was being solved. If you are still being affected by these issues after restarting your client and receiving the hotfix, please let us know via Support Ticket.

notes.title: [BGM Movie Trailer] “Onmyoji” Official Trailer #1 / SFA - Heaven on Earth
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

Introducing our new [BGM Movie Trailer] “Onmyoji” Official Trailer #1


https://youtu.be/BEJ_4ssWeOo?list=PLXt1p00-_JTYYfiv2DfqJIq2uGTC-nm07


● Onmyoji

About 90 years ago, the first Onmyoji abandoned their homeland and made way to our blessed Kingdom, where they took on different positions at the service of the Royal Court. Though their work in the Court ended 4 decades ago, the Onmyoji remain in the Kingdom, quietly tending to their craft in communion with the local people. That, they believe, is the way to creating a place for the Onmyoji in our society. After Medzio Diena, they have focused their efforts on addressing the hardships of a nation struck by catastrophe through the harmonious ways of their class.

It is in the balance of heaven and earth, light and dark, yin and yang that the Onmyoji find the source of their power, and nowhere are these forces better represented than in the union of the human body and spirit, which stand between heaven and earth. That is why the Onmyoji imbue their power onto sheets of paper cut out into human shapes. The energies in equilibrium manifest themselves in the properties of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal and Water, which are known as the Five Elements. The Onmyoji can use these properties not only to confuse and attack their enemies, but to protect themselves as well.

In recent times, Onmyoji Master Ahiro Seimei was involved in mediating between his country of origin and the Kingdom he now calls home. According to what was reported, the Master had been tasked with attending to complex diplomatic requests coming from his homeland while minimizing the burden on our Kingdom’s authorities. Thanks to his harmonious nature, Seimei managed to gather the support of other Class Masters, who helped him fulfill his duty most successfully.

Besides his work on the balance of the Five Elements under the rule of the goddesses and divine spirits, the Onmyoji Master is also particularly concerned with achieving harmony in the relations between his native country and our nation.

Fortunately, the Kingdom’s divine spirits are known to be gentle and temperate, allowing the Onmyoji Master a certain degree of freedom in his work. On the other hand, the burden of communicating with the divine spirits is one he shares with the Miko Master, whose carefree personality at times hinders his intentions.

In an era where the Onmyoji are no longer newcomers but integrated subjects of the Kingdom, the aftermath of Medzio Diena is heavy on the young Master’s shoulders, but our people trust his strong dedication to harmony to lead us into peaceful days, where the Kingdom and its divine spirits can live happily under the grace of the goddesses.

● Lyrics

As time flows by like a river
Pines and forest are evergreen
Cherry blossoms bloom gracefully
But my joy and sorrow wither away

As my heart drifts away into the Southern wind
Memories of summer breeze fill the air
Though I yearn for my homeland for a thousand times
My vision will be burnt into ashes

As my heart drifts away into the Northern wind
Memories of autumn bliss caress my soul
Though I yearn for my homeland for a thousand times
Every dream will be burnt into ashes

As I pray day and night under the sun and moon
Everlasting peace on Heaven and Earth
May the gods protect us from the skies above
And unite the nation in one like Yin and Yang

Winter has arrived in the shrine
May my home be safe as sound
I believe with the sovereign’s guide
We will have a miracle in store

Heaven on Earth (Onmyoji Main BGM)
Composed by SFA

notes.title: [BGM Movie Trailer] “Retiarius” Official Trailer #1 / Kevin - Ra Reina
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

Introducing our new [BGM Movie Trailer] “Ratiarius” Official Trailer #1


https://youtu.be/ulC2D90LPRU?list=PLXt1p00-_JTYYfiv2DfqJIq2uGTC-nm07

● Retiarius

In combat, the Retiarius’ main weapons are the net (called the ‘rete’), the trident, and the dagger. Though seemingly harmless at first glance, the rete is used to entrap enemies or pull them towards the Retiarius with one hand while the other attacks with the weapon. Also, the rete allows fighters to reach multiple enemies at once, a move which never fails to impress their audiences. This class is well-known for their dauntless displays in the arena, and the rete-based combat style is a crucial part of that.

Reriarius Master Caecilia, however, knows that fame is only momentary, as the public will always admire the strongest champions. Because of this, her determination to survive in the arena has allowed her to make a name for herself as Class Master. Many believe that, after losing her father in a combat accident and removing herself from the arena, she has returned only because of the events of Medzio Diena. However, her true intentions remain a mystery.

There are no eternal victors in the world of gladiators; defeat is an inevitable part of the experience. Despite this, the Retiarii have remained the most popular arena fighters for centuries, in large due to an old story dating back to the reign of King Kadumel, a story which also happens to depict the unfortunate temperament of the infamous tyrant.

One very famous Retiarius lived in the era of King Kadumel. This particular Retiarius was known for almost never wearing a helmet, in part because regulations at the time were nonexistent, but mostly to flaunt his well-sculpted features, or so the rumors said. One day at a tournament, the crowd was especially excited for his performance. When the referee finally gave the fighters the sign to attack, the handsome Retiarius immediately threw his rete upwards in the direction of his opponent. He knew that any competent gladiator would detect the trajectory of a descending net in seconds and escape before it could hit them.

That day, however, the Retiarius’ nimble attack failed to suppress his enemy, who had blocked the net with his shield. The crowd’s excitement dwelled down at the sight of their champion’s mistake. The Retiarius could no longer attack; the other gladiator had already breached the distance between them and reflected away his trident away with a throw of the dagger directed at his torso.

He fell to his knees. The shouting crowd and loud music around him drowned the Retiarius’ cry of pain. The referee quickly interrupted the battle to stand between the two men, looking up at King Kadumel who was watching from the royal box. The king did not ponder for long before ordering the gladiator to finish off the defeated Retiarius. As it later came to be known, the king had only sentenced the champion to death in order to win a personal bet, an act not unexpected of a monarch as ruthless as Kadumel.

The handsome Retiarius’ death became the most well-known incident in the arena under King Kadumel’s rule. After his reign, the Court abolished the practice of deciding the fate of their gladiators, and Retiarii gained the massive popularity they still carry to this day.

Most of the Kingdom’s combat arenas have closed since Medzio Diena, making it difficult for those in the field to host tournaments. Despite this, the Retiarius Master continues to train new fighters as a way to address the constant struggle for survival in today’s world and preserve the important role of gladiators in society.

● Lyrics

Finally called
To the place legends are born
And the blade of death is nowhere to be seen

Journey continues
As the day begins anew
Hear the heroes anthem as it brings you peace

There are times when you will fail
Wrecked into pieces
Cast by the shadows of fear
But despair will not be your last fate

Fight on for justice
Freedom and salvation
This is where you belong
I will be your savior

You’ll survive no matter what
I’ll be the strength in your whole life
You’ve come down a long way road
And now this path shall be yours forevermore

Lost in the dark
Where the beasts begin to lurk
Ready to ambush and tear your soul into two

Fear strikes once again
Driving you insane
Lost in the tempest and fail to escape

There are times when you will try
But end up falling
With guidance I bring into you
No discourage shall be in your way

Fight on for justice
Freedom and salvation
This is where you belong
I will be your savior

You’ll survive no matter what
I’ll be the strength in your whole life
You’ve come down a long way road
And now this path shall be yours forevermore

Ra Reina (Retiarius Main BGM)
Composed by Kevin

notes.title: Future Silver Adjustments
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

It’s your dev team, here to talk about some changes that are being planned regarding the use of Silver in Tree of Savior.

After the last Rank update, our game was affected by a Silver inflation that has been growing more and more severe as time goes by. For an economy-based MMORPG, inflation is one of the most telling signs of danger, which is why we need to look for ways to adjust the routes of Silver supply and consumption in TOS.

Link: https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=1275

notes.title: [UPDATE] Known Issues: January 31, 2018
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

The following issues have recently been reported and are being investigated.


1) Irregular NPCs in [NA] Klaipeda cities

- Players have reported certain NPCs appearing in irregular locations and becoming impossible to interact with on several channels of the Klaipeda map in the [NA] Klaipeda server.

We are now looking into the source of the problem. While this process is ongoing, note that you maybe able to use the affected NPCs only on specific channels of Klaipeda.


2) Recipe Missing From Event Box

- The Emengard Cannon recipe has been reported to be missing from the options of the Secret Recipe Selection Box (14 Days) obtainable through the Fedimian's Secret Night Market event.

This issue is set to be fixed during the scheduled maintenance of February 6, 2018. If you would like to obtain the Emengard Cannon recipe through this event, you may do so after the scheduled maintenance.

We will update this announcement at the link below once we obtain more details about the errors reported. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=1246

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/18214932/158acbe2dfff1ce800af3f48c10f8e30dd5a70b2.jpg[/img]

Greetings, Saviors!

Come on over to the servers this weekend for two days of double EXP!

[u][b]Event Period[/b][/u]
FROM February 3, 2018 at 00:00 (server time)
TO February 4, 2018 at 23:59 (server time)

[u][b]Who Can Participate[/b][/u]
- All characters

[u][b]How to Participate[/b][/u]
- Simply login to your server during the event period to receive two times the EXP gains on all your characters! You can check your total EXP UP bonuses in the Character Info window (F1).

notes.title: Known Issues: January 24, 2018
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

The following issues have recently been reported and are being investigated.


1) TP Purchase Error

We are currently in contact with Valve to discover the source of the issue and address it as soon as possible.

We will update this announcement at the link below once we obtain more details about the errors reported. Thank you for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Dev Interview: Legend Cards
notes.content:

We were curious to see how this feature was looking so far and what we could expect when it finally comes out in the game, so we took some time to test it out with the developer in charge.

Check out the full post at our dev blog from the link below!

notes.title: Known Issues: October 24, 2017
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.
 
We are currently aware of the following issues. We will keep you updated on further procedures.

[b]1) Disconnect in Halloween Event Dungeon[/b]

Players have reported that they are facing random disconnects from the server while in the Halloween Event Dungeon, "Creepy Klaipeda." We are currently investigating the matter. 

============================================================================
Please let us know via Support Ticket if you are experiencing other problems. When reporting issues, please be as detailed as possible. 
Screenshots, character/team/server/class details and timestamps would be greatly appreciated. The more information we have on a specific issue, the quicker it will be resolved.

notes.title: [HOTFIX] Guilds Facing Issues Logging In
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

After the scheduled maintenance on September 26th, some guilds have reported connection issues and extreme lag while playing. 

We would like to announce that we have implemented a hotfix to address the error and that you will need to restart the game to ensure that these changes are applied. 

We would also like to request that players, after receiving this hotfix, continue to send us their lastreply files from the following directory:

Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/replay/lastreplay 

Please do not send us files from before today's hotfix as it will not provide the data we are looking for. 

Also please note that you do not have to use the F12 function to record anything. The file will be automatically created.

We apologize for the inconvenience.

notes.title: [SA] Adventure Journal Points Delayed to Oct 10
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

As you may know from the [url=https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=1112]patch notes of today’s scheduled maintenance[/url], this week’s big update includes the new version of the Adventure Journal, with new rewards for Growth and Exploration delivered based on your previous achievements.

In order to apply this update to the game, all points obtained in those categories must be converted into the new point system in order for players to receive the corresponding rewards once they login after the maintenance.

Unfortunately, processing that data in [SA] Silute is taking longer than expected, so we have decided to [b]open the server WITHOUT applying the new Adventure Journal points for the time being[/b]. These points will be [b]applied during the next scheduled maintenance on October 10, 2017[/b].

We would like to note that your Growth and Exploration point data is safely stored and intact (this includes your previous data as well as the new data generated after you log back into the server). We are merely delaying their application to the game in order to avoid denying access to the server any longer.

We apologize for this issue and thank you for your patience while the new Adventure Journal point data is being processed.

notes.title: [HOTFIX] The Masters’ Unit Badge Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

After the scheduled maintenance on September 12, some players have been unable to obtain their daily Master Badge through The Masters’ Unit event that began on the same day.

We would like to announce that the error that was causing this issue has been fixed. You should now be able to obtain one Master Badge per day (per team) after completing the event mission.

To compensate for the missing badge, players who were affected by this error will receive 2 Master Badges the next time they participate in the event mission through the Event Notice Board. This will only apply one time.

[u][b]IMPORTANT: You will need to restart your game client in order for the hotfix to be applied.[/b][/u]

Remember that The Masters’ Unit event mission daily count resets at 6 AM (server time), while the time to obtain the Master Badge resets at midnight (server time).

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your patience while the issue was being solved.

notes.title: Monthly TP Spending Limits Applied
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

In order to prevent payment fraud-related issues from affecting the game, starting from this week’s scheduled maintenance (July 4, 2017), we will be adopting a monthly TP spending limit for Steam accounts that have a shorter payment record since their time of creation.

If you find that a TP spending limit has been applied to your account and want this restriction to be removed, kindly send a ticket via our Support page under the “Payment” >> “Reset TP Spending Limit” category so we can verify and process your request individually.

See the link below for the full announcement:

https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=1033

notes.title: Dev Interview: Klaipeda’s New Face
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

Now that Klaipeda has become the starting city for all characters and home of the popular Mercenary Post, many have come to settle in the new bustling hub.

Klaipeda’s evolution is far from over, however. The devs are planning a large-scale renovation of the city that promises to turn the old town into a wider, more welcoming home for all adventurers.

We sat down with Tree of Savior’s head of development (HOD), who’s in charge of planning the renovation, and our art director Maggi, responsible for designing the city's revamped façade, to find out more about Klaipeda’s new face.

Head over to our Official Website to read more : https://treeofsavior.com/page/news/view.php?n=999

notes.title: [COMPLETE] Temporary Maintenance Notice - June 2, 2017
notes.content:
[COMPLETE] We have run into issues on the [SA] Silute server. As such, the [SA] Silute server will undergo additional maintenance. 

Our most sincere apologies to the [SA] Silute server players.

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Greetings, Saviors!

We will soon carry out maintenance across all servers due to the following reasons.

1. On May 30, 2017, we had announced that 'DPK ratings will no longer be reset when a server is restarted for maintenance purposes or abnormally.'

However, we have found that there were issues where the DPK of certain items were found to be abnormal. 

As such, the lower DPK ratings will be fixed during this maintenance.


2. We have discovered that the Fortune Cookies obtained from the 'Luck of the Anvils' event had been erroneously giving 7-day Tokens.

All such Tokens will be removed and Token benefit time deducted from those that have already used the Tokens. Our sincere apologies for the confusion.

This maintenance is expected to take place during the following period:

[EDT] 03:00 to 04:00
[BRT] 04:00 to 05:00
[CEST] 09:00 to 10:00
[SGT] 15:00 to 16:00

Note that this maintenance is affecting all servers. We will update this announcement once maintenance is completed.

Thank you for understanding.

notes.title: The Leaf Penguin is Here!

Please check your the Message Box at your in-game lodge to receive one Leaf Penguin Egg.

To hatch the egg, simply give it to one of your characters and right-click it from the inventory. You will then be prompted to enter a name for your Leaf Penguin, after which it will hatch from the egg!

Remember that you can always change the Leaf Penguin to another character of yours at the lodge.

notes.title: Adventure Journal Renewal – First Notice
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We’re planning to improve on some of the problems affecting Adventure Journal contents, and for that we would like to notify you of a few big changes that are taking place in the near future.

[b]1) Data registered in the Adventure Journal will be applied on a per-team basis, instead of the current per-character setup.[/b]

This means you will have a single Adventure Journal shared with all the characters of your team, and the contents you play with each character will all contribute to your team’s common Adventure Journal.

[b]2) Data currently registered in Adventure Journals will be deleted, and all compensation-related content will be revised.[/b]

[b]3) Current Adventure Journal rewards can only be received before the renewal, so make sure to collect any rewards you may have from your Adventure Journal achievements before the changes are applied.[/b]

Details about which contents will be changed and how they will change will be shared in a future announcement, along with the renewal schedule. Make sure to keep an eye on our News page for more updates.

notes.title: Notice on the Instanced Dungeon Reset Issue
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We would like to announce that we have applied a client patch via hotfix to correct the issue that, for the past days, has caused the daily instanced dungeon and mission entries of some or all of a team’s characters to not reset at the correct time.

As you may be aware from reading our patch notes, our team has been closely monitoring this issue and attempting several times to correct it. We recorded the logs of any errors that occurred and, based on the results, corrected the components suspected of causing the problem, gradually narrowing down the possible origins of the initial error.

Unfortunately, this being an issue which affects players in specific situations, it has taken us longer than usual to trace the source of the problem and correct it, and we apologize for the inconvenience it has caused.

Kindly let us know through a ticket at our Support page if you are still experiencing this issue after today. Keep in mind the time at which instanced dungeons/missions reset: (server time) NA/SA 06:00, EU 00:00, SEA 18:00.

[b]IMPORTANT:[/b]

1) Make sure to receive the latest TOS patch (April 21) to ensure that the fix is applied. You will need to apply the new patch even if you already have the patch from the latest maintenance (April 18). If you currently have the client open, you will have to close the game and open it again to receive the latest patch.

2) Daily instanced dungeon/mission entries should reset properly starting today, April 21, 2017 (yesterday's entries will not reset immediately). To confirm whether your entries were correctly reset, please check them AFTER the following times:

NA/SA: [EDT] 06:00 (server time 06:00)
EU: [CET] 06:00 (server time 00:00)
SEA: [SGT] 06:00 (server time 18:00)

Thank you.

Maintenance is expected to take place on [b]April 19-20, 2017[/b]. The exact schedule details will be published soon in a separate announcement, so make sure to keep an eye on our News page.

Note that this maintenance is [b]NOT a server transfer[/b], meaning we will not be transferring teams from one server to another.

The maintenance will not change any aspects about your team, items, etc. so if you are playing in [SA] Silute, you will not have to take special measures before the maintenance. Simply be aware of the time when the maintenance begins (again, look for a future announcement with schedule details).

notes.title: Plans for Combat System Changes
notes.content:
Greetings, TOS dev team here.

Our general goal for the year, besides system stabilization, has been creating and revising contents as a way to develop the gameplay of Tree of Savior into a more pleasant one for every player. 

The first big aspect we have in mind is PvP play, especially in terms of Team Battle League rules and general environment, and GvG stabilization. 

The second aspect we want to focus on are ways to connect the main storyline of TOS with future field, dungeon and raid updates.

The combat system changes we’re discussing today are deeply related to several aspects of the game we’re trying to improve with our plan, so we feel like they’re crucial when trying to produce noticeable results.

In order to read more, please head over to the announcement on our [url=https://treeofsavior.com/news/?n=920]Official Website[/url].

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Help us reduce issues with claiming TP Bundles!
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors,

We would like to announce that we will be offering 20% additional TP as compensation for any players who may have issues with claiming their TP Bundle purchases made from now until April 30th. 

We wish to use this chance as a way to apologize for the continued issues with regards to the TP claiming process and to show our willingness to solve these issues. There has been a lot of tinkering behind the scenes to smoothen out the process, but we admit that it can always be better. 

Please carefully read the details below to see how you can help us improve our TP distribution process as well as gain additional TP in the process. If you require any help on how to claim your TP Bundles, make sure to check out our guide [url=https://treeofsavior.com/guide/#]here[/url].

The following list shows how much TP you will be compensated with if you have an issue with a certain TP Bundle product.

- Per 100 TP Bundle (100 TP) : Compensation of 20 TP

- Per 300 TP Bundle (310 TP) : Compensation of 70 TP

- Per 500 TP Bundle (530 TP) : Compensation of 110 TP

- Per 900 TP Bundle (990 TP) : Compensation of 200 TP

IMPORTANT : Please read the following conditions to see if you are applicable for compensation.

1-1. You must have either pressed the 'USE' button OR used the '/retrieveAllItems' command in order to start the TP claiming process.

1-2. Any attempts at claiming TP Bundles not meant for your server region will not be counted.

2. A minimum of 24 hours must have passed after the initial start of the TP claiming process (Condition 1-1).

3. You must send us a Ticket via the [url=https://treeofsavior.com/inquiry/]Support Page[/url] when the issue arises.

4. Any attempts at abusing the system may result in you becoming inapplicable for compensation.

 
Thank you as always for the continued love, support, and attention.
 

Best regards,

IMC Staff

notes.title: New Regional Guild Battle Format
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

First, we know that it came as a rude surprise when we rather suddenly removed Guild Battles without proper prior notice, and for that we would like to apologize. This had to do with a few reasons, mainly issues related to stability and the rewards.

We felt that we were not able to stabilize Regional Guild Battles at a satisfactory rate, and that the rewards should be more about honor and showing off your guild's victories in a way that is recognizable to other players.

However, we know that many players still enjoy the contents, and we would like to see them return. As such, we would like to announce that we are bringing back Regional Guild Battles [next week], but in a different format. Since we are still working on ironing out the kinks, we will avoid any automation that might cause more issues.

Also, we will be continuously analyzing the data and feedback from the new seasons in order to improve playability.

Please head over to our official website for more details : https://treeofsavior.com/news/?n=854

notes.title: New Emoticons! Emote Plus: Popolion
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

There’s a package with new premium emoticons ready to be released in the TP Shop very soon. The ‘Emote Plus: Popolion’ package contains 23 new emoticons for use in the in-game chat function, featuring our very own TOS monsters.

[b]NOTE[/b]: This emoticon package is character-bound, meaning that only the character that purchases it will be able to use the emoticons in the game. The emoticon package cannot be traded or moved via Team Storage. To use these emoticons with another character, you will need to purchase an additional package with the desired character.

The ‘Emote Plus: Popolion’ package will be available in the TP Shop after the maintenance on January 10, 2017.

Visit our Official Website for more details : https://treeofsavior.com/news/?n=800

notes.title: Known Issues: December 23rd, 2016
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

The following is a list of pressing issues and bugs that have been reported to us and are currently being worked on.

[b]1) Buffs canceling after moving maps[/b]
- Certain buffs are known to get automatically canceled whenever the character moves to a different map, even when there is still time left on the specific buff.

[b]2) Unable to equip bracelets in [NA] Klaipeda[/b]
- Characters have been reportedly unable to equip any bracelet items in channel 1 maps of the [NA] Klaipeda server. Equipped bracelet items will also automatically unequip upon changing to channel 1.

[b]3) Unable to enter Team Battle League[/b]
- There is an ongoing issue with certain characters being unable to enter Team Battle League matches after queuing up, resulting in only part of the team members joining the battle.

notes.title: [UPDATE] Regarding Latest Mission Boss Issues
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We’ve been receiving reports of a couple of issues that have recently started affecting missions in the game. Boss monsters have been known to drop no silver or cubes, and show no ranking after being defeated. 

We would like to let you know that we are aware of these issues and currently working to get them fixed as soon as possible.

We will ask you to kindly report any problems you encounter with a ticket via our Support page. Please provide any details possible regarding what mission/dungeon you played, whether your party was auto-matched or premade, and any other useful details. 

There is a possibility that these errors are caused by large level gaps within members of the same party, so please include your character level and your party members’ as well when you submit your report.

Thank you.

[b]UPDATE[/b]: Please make sure that your revision number in the 'release.revision.txt' file in the following folder (Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release) is number 139117.

If this is not the number you see on the file, it means your current patch is incomplete. Please try verifying game file integrity on Steam or redownloading the patch.

notes.title: Announcement regarding event rewards
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors,
 

We would like to announce that there was a slight issue with the event rewards for the first day. Several players were able to obtain rewards meant for another day instead of the rewards intended to be given for the first day.
 
This was unintentional and we have reset the properties related to the event as of 05:20 A.M. (EDT) September 13th, 2016. Players will now receive the intended reward for the first day. 
 

Any players that have finished the quest before this time will have had their quest status reset. Therefore, those players will be able to do the event quest once more and receive the rewards for the first day. Please make sure to redo today's event quest before the day is over to be able to receive the second reward tomorrow.
 
We offer our most sincere apologies for any confusion caused by the mixed rewards for the event.


Sincerely,
IMC Games

notes.title: [COMPLETE] Scheduled Maintenance for June 7th, 2016
notes.content:
[b]UPDATE - MAINTENANCE COMPLETE:[/b] The servers are back up and you can login to the worlds now. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by extended maintenance time.

[b]Compensation for maintenance extension:[/b] EXP Tome x4, 12-hour Token time extension

[b]Additional patch notes:[/b] Characters are now unable to set up a shop when being targeted for attack by at least one monster.

[strike]UPDATE 3 - MAINTENANCE EXTENDED: Today's maintenance has been further extended. We will work on getting the servers back online as soon as possible.  Additional compensation will be provided accordingly. We apologize once again for the inconvenience and thank you for your understanding.[/strike]

[strike]UPDATE 2 - MAINTENANCE EXTENDED: We regret to inform that our maintenance has been further extended by one hour. The maintenance period is thus expected to finish at EDT 08:00, June 7. We apologize for the inconvenience.[/strike]

[strike]UPDATE - MAINTENANCE EXTENDED: We regret to inform that our maintenance has been extended by one hour. The maintenance period is thus expected to finish at EDT 07:00, June 7.[/strike]

Greetings, Saviors!

We would like to announce the details of our weekly maintenance for June 7th, 2016. Make sure to check below for the maintenance schedule and patch notes.

Please note that other issues and bugs are also being worked on even if they are not mentioned below.


[Maintenance Period]

01:00 to 06:00 (EDT) June 7th, 2016

[Patch Notes]

1. General Contents

- The price of Tokens in the TP Shop will be reduced from 198 TP to 99 TP (https://treeofsavior.com/news/?n=434&vp=2)
- Three new loading images have been added.

2. Quest Related

- The First Epitaph (1): The problem of being unable to get the Flat Stone back after canceling the process of making a shovel has been fixed.
- Can't Be Taken Away (2): You will now be able to obtain Condensed Cursed Energy from Red Wood Goblins.
- Pull out the Metal Plate: You can now complete the quest even if your summons or companions defeat the monster.

3. Skill Related

3.1 Cleric Skills
  > Cure: Fixed the problem of the sound getting muted when Cure: Damage Interval is active.
3.2 Krivis Skills
  > Melstis: Consumables can no longer be used while casting this skill.
3.3 Thaumaturge Skills
  > Swell Left Arm and Swell Right Arm: The equipment on the corresponding arm will now increase in size when using these skills.

4. Warp

- Warp prices will no longer appear on-screen when using a Warp Scroll.
- Moving to the map where the Warp Scroll was last used will no longer be impossible when the amount of silver carried by the character is insufficient.
- Hitting the space bar consecutively when warping at the Second Demon Prison will no longer make the character warp multiple times.

5. Cloaking

- Heal and font effects on enemy characters will no longer be shown when they are Cloaking.
- Guild members in a Cloaking state will now appear translucent.

6. Miscellaneous

- Companions will now look in the same direction as your character when close by, and face towards your character when far away.
- In mouse mode, the attack speed will no longer be faster than normal.


As always, we thank you for your continued support, enthusiasm and love for Tree of Savior.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: [Guild Delete Exploit] Now Accepting Guild Restore Requests
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We recently fixed an exploit in the game that allowed players to disband their guilds without becoming the guild master (more details here). As a result, several guilds have reportedly been deleted unintentionally.

We are planning to restore all guilds disbanded through this exploit during our next scheduled maintenance on May 24, 2016, and will now start accepting requests via Support ticket.

Guild masters of guilds affected by the exploit may send in their requests via Support ticket (Type: Etc) until [b][EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM[/b].

Before you send in your request, make sure you read and understand the conditions below:

- Only guild masters may submit a restore request for their guild
- Requests must be submitted via Support ticket (Type: Etc)
- We will accept requests submitted until [EDT] Sunday, May 22, 2016, at 11:59 PM

How to submit your request via Support ticket (only submit if you are the guild master):

1) Go to the Support Page on our official website
2) If you haven't, verify your Steam account
3) Click on Submit Ticket
4) Select Type: Etc, then enter your information on the fields shown
5) Enter the following in Title: -GUILD RESTORE- YOUR GUILD NAME
6) In Description, enter the following information
   - Server:
   - Guild name:
   - Guild master character's name:
   - Approx. date and time guild was deleted (EDT):

Let us know if you run into trouble when submitting your request.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Tree of Savior review
notes.content:
Need to know

What is it? A free-to-play Korean MMORPG with a old school vibe. Reviewed On: Windows 10, i5 3570k, 16GB Ram, GTX 970 Price: Free-to-play with microtransactions Release Date: Out now Publisher: IMC Games Co. Ltd. Developer: IMC Games Co. Ltd. Multiplayer: MMO Link: Official Website 

Grinding has always been a dirty word in online role-playing games, but it's one that, for better and for worse, Tree of Savior proudly wears on its sleeve. When I wasn't grinding levels, I was grinding for new equipment or grinding money to afford upgrading that equipment. And when I realized I hated the class I chose after two dozen hours, I began that grind from the beginning. But for all those hours spent squeezing experience points from enemy corpses like water from a desert cactus, there's something about Tree of Savior that keeps me coming back or maybe I've just spent so long with it I'm taking my captor's side.

That grinding is the heart of Tree of Savior won't be a surprise to anyone familiar with its spiritual predecessor Ragnarok Online, the long-running Korean MMORPG. Tree of Savior bears more than a few similarities, but its expansive class system and gorgeous presentation make it much more than just a rehash of an older game. With over 80 different classes, Tree of Savior offers one of the most robust progression systems I've ever seen but learning its ins and outs has been as painful as fun.

A class act

There's only four base classes to choose from when starting out, but I eventually unlocked new ones I could stack on top of my base class, adding more abilities that redefined my character. This process happens six times over Tree of Savior's 200-plus levels, creating a ton of complexity that had the part of my brain that loves theorycrafting dizzy with all the possibilities. This all plays out rather slowly as you explore the world, completing quests or tracking down monsters to kill in hopes of getting a specific piece of gear. Fully exploring maps or collecting specific items dropped from monsters can also net you bonuses like extra experience or permanent stat increases from NPCs in each town. While I played mostly alone, there was always the option to join up and murder the incredible variety of monsters that dot the landscape as a group, potentially increasing how fast I could level.

Unfortunately, much of that potential is wasted on poor class balancing. Not every option you choose will be viable, and in true old school RPG fashion, it's possible to ruin your build if you don't know what you're doing. Those dead ends wouldn't be so painful if Tree of Savior provided an option to salvage mistakes which it partially does in the form of potions that can reset skill points in exchange for real cash. Class choices and allocated stat points, however, are permanent.

Knowing this, I felt terrified of making my own choices when building my character, which is a huge disappointment given how rewarding this system could be if it would let me experiment without potentially wasting so many hours. Instead, I took to community websites to get inspiration from popular builds, but character progression happens so slowly that it's impossible to tell if a class suited my playstyle until after I had sunk dozens of hours into it. That's exactly why my poor hoplite has been gathering dust in the character select screen. His reliance on passive buffs to enhance his basic attack is painfully boring.

While some might praise this aspect of Tree of Savior as hardcore, I'd argue it's simply unfun and needlessly punishing. There are truly original ideas behind some classes, like alchemists being able to "awaken" an item's potential by braving a special dungeon or squires being able to set up vendor stalls in town to repair equipment. But one wrong move or one unfavorable balance update and all those hours invested in building them could be wasted.

The extreme variety of classes also means that there's an extreme variety to combat. My hoplite ran around smacking enemies with his basic attack and bored me to tears, but my new wizard delightfully devastates whole groups of enemies with her spells. When this new build clicked, I entered into an intoxicating rhythm where hours melted away as quickly as the monsters before me. Enemies burst like pinatas when they die, and the catchy music and vibrant spell animations make Tree of Savior scarily capable of turning me into a grind-zombie.

And then a crippling bout of latency grips the servers and the next fifteen minutes are spent wrestling with an unresponsive interface and delayed combat animations. That spell Tree of Savior cast over me is gone and I'm back to wondering whether all these hours are even worth it. While the free-to-play launch is certainly pushing the servers to their limits, many of these problems existed in the quieter early access period too. There's the option to switch "channels" within a map to find one less crowded and more stable, but it feels like a poorly designed and anti-social solution.

 Technical troubles

Tree of Savior's hand-painted aesthetic is absolutely stunning, but it's far from being the kind of technical marvel that could ever justify the constant frame dips and unstable server connection I've experienced. While I can grit my teeth through dips in framerate, server lag is a far more lethal enemy. Slow connections can make classes dependant on quick reactions unviable as if I needed even more reasons to be terrified of committing to one type of character. Coupled with the fact that some classes aren't suited to using certain control schemes (in-game messages warn me that using a mouse to control my hoplite isn't recommended) and suddenly 80 classes feels like only a few actual choices.

That so many hurdles stand between me and how I want to play Tree of Savior is frustrating only because I believe this could be a game I would want to spend more time in. With such a singular focus on grinding, Tree of Savior sometimes displays a real mastery of what can make that grind fun. The pacing through levels and new maps is so quick that I often have trouble logging off at night, which starkly contrasts how I feel the next morning when the spell has worn off and I have to force myself to log back in.

There's a powerful sense of nostalgia buried within Tree of Savior, a deep love for a time when MMORPGs offered freedom and simpler pleasures accented by the risk of failure. The expression of that love is a frustrating, broken, and sometimes wonderful thing. My journey through building my hero and grinding is one of confliction. Even while I might persist along that road, I'm not so sure I'd ever recommend you follow.

notes.content:

Greetings Saviors!

Here's an announcement to summarize and confirm some details of what's changing after today's weekly maintenance.

[h1]F2P Transition Schedule[/h1]

Finally, should the number of players in another server justify it, we will consider opening more servers in the relevant regions, so make sure to keep an eye out for any future announcements regarding these and other updates.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: [Updated] Announcement Regarding [SA]Silute Server Connection Issues - May 5th
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors!

We would like to give you an update on the connection issues with the Silute server. 

The server seems to have become unstable due to the network being overloaded. We have been looking into the situation and will provide you with an update on the matter as soon as possible.

We apologize for any and all inconvenience that you may have experienced from this problem.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

[b][UPDATE][/b]
It seems a DDoS attack to our servers was the cause of the instability and AWS has blocked certain IP addresses as a response to the attacks.

We are currently contacting AWS to check the systems and consult our course of action in case of future attacks.

If there are any players that are unable to access the game, please send in another ticket with your IP address and server. We will be able to use the information to resolve this situation as soon as possible.

notes.title: Announcement on the DLC & TP Products and F2P Transition
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

With the date of Tree of Savior's F2P release nearing, we have some announcements to make regarding the sales of our products on Steam and our current plans on the SEA server, Telsiai.

First, all of the DLC products we currently have on sale will go down on May 9th. We've requested Steam to take down these products on that date, so we expect the products to be unavailable for purchase then and thereafter. In addition, we'll be selling three types of TP bundles, 100TP / 300TP / 500TP respectively, that are to be region specific soon after the game's open release. You will not be able to use a different region's TP bundle on another regional server. Please look out for our announcements on the exact date the TP bundles will be available on Steam.

We would also like to let you know about the F2P servers many players may be wondering about. Previously, we announced that we plan on opening new servers to meet the influx of new players in [url=https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/current-plans-regarding-the-transition-to-f2p-updated-march-28th/154509]this announcement[/url].

We currently have an overload of players on Telsiai, so we've decided to open a new server for Telsiai first, on the day we release the game as free-to-play. The name of the new SEA server is Varena, and new SEA players will be able to start only on this server. [b]Access to Telsiai will [i][u]temporarily[/u][/i] become exclusive to players who have started playing on it before the game's F2P release[/b], namely those who purchased at least one of the DLC products. This only applies to Telsiai and not any other servers.

New servers for other regions are TBA, and we will open them accordingly if there are enough new players.

Lastly, the regular maintenance on Tuesday, May 10th, will be scheduled a bit differently. We'll start the maintenance an hour early, at 12:00 am EDT, and finish at 6:00 am EDT.

As always, we thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We hope to bring satisfactory service and an enjoyable game to our players.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Server Transfer - Now Taking Requests
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We'd like to announce that we're now taking requests for server transfers. If you wish to transfer your team to another server, now's your chance to send in your request ticket.

Prior to requesting team transfers, please make sure you have fully read and understood the terms and conditions regarding this service. In addition, there are several things to be checked before you can file request tickets.

Everything you need to know about team transfers is highlighted on this post: [url=https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/server-transfer-details-and-conditions/191657]https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/server-transfer-details-and-conditions/191657[/url]

If your team is fully prepared for the transfer, please follow these steps to send in your request:

(1) Go to the support page on our official website.

(2) Log into your Facebook or Google account.

(3) Verify your Steam account by clicking on the top right corner. You will then see the [Submit Ticket] option on the lower right corner of the support page.

(4) After you click on [Submit Ticket], use the drop-down menu to select [Server Transfer] as your ticket type, or just follow this link: [url=https://treeofsavior.com/inquiry/?c=15]https://treeofsavior.com/inquiry/?c=15[/url]

(5) You will be prompted to check that you have read and understood the terms and conditions of server transfer. Proceed to fill out the necessary details to submit your request.

We will be taking requests until April 24th, then proceed to move everyone's teams to the requested servers during our weekly maintenance on April 26th. You will not have access to the game during the maintenance.

Please remember that the transfer process is irreversible, and you should take the extra steps necessary to ensure you wish to move your entire team to another server. We will not be responsible for unwanted team transfers caused by players' neglection in confirming the transfer conditions.

Thank you for your attention and cooperation.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Changes to Market and Trade Use for New Teams
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

Apart from the administration of fraudulent billing and purchase activities by Valve's fraud department, we've implemented our own mechanism to provide additional security measures.

[b]Newly created teams will not be able to register items on the market and participate in 1:1 trades for 3 days (72 hours). After the 72-hour mark, players will be able to fully use the market and trade systems as intended.[/b]

*You can still [i]purchase[/i] items from the Market.

We'll be checking for cases of abuse during those 3 days, and block abusers and confiscate their items as necessary.

We hope to maintain a reliable in-game economy by preventing abusive commercial activities ahead of time, and request your cooperation.

We will be performing a temporary server maintenance to apply these changes as a patch. Please look out for our maintenance announcement on this particular feature.

Thank you for your kind understanding.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: [UPDATE][Complete] Scheduled Maintenance & Patch Notes - April 12th, 2016
notes.content:
Greetings Saviors!

As previously announced, the servers will be undergoing some maintenance and we would like to let you know what is to be patched during the maintenance period. We also wish to apologize and compensate for the recent issue where users were unable to access dungeons through the party matchmaking system.


[b]Maintenance Period[/b] : 01:00~06:00 AM (EDT) April 12th, 2016

[b]Patch Notes :[/b]
[list]
 [*]You will now be able to access the Ausrine Goddess Statue in the city of Orsha.

 [*]Collection: Ashaq Underground Prison 2F will now function as intended.

 [*]Item distribution will now function properly in parties.

 [*]We've added the option to turn off/on screen shake under "Game Settings."

 [*]We reduced the number of channels in lower level maps while increasing them in higher level maps.

 [*]The issue of monster gem's status changes not being displayed upon equipment has been fixed.

 [*]2nd Demon Prison mob: Key Thief's level has been adjusted properly (194 to 164)

 [*]Kabbalist's skill Gematria: The client will no longer crash when using the skill.

 [*]You can now enter Vera and Igti Coasts without getting the message "This channel is full."

 [*]You can now report bots in-game. If you suspect a user is botting, report them to us by right-clicking on them and selecting [Report bot]. We'll investigate the reported users and block them accordingly.
[/list]

Please note that we are still working on some of the more major tweaks and will patch them as soon as possible.

Thank you for all your patience and understanding. We will strive to provide a service that is worthy of your enthusiasm and support.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff


[UPDATE]
We are aware that some players are experiencing problems patching and launching the game at the moment. We are looking into the issue, but in the meantime here is the workaround. Apologies for the inconvenience.

 - Go to [i][b]Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release[/b][/i]
 - Open the [i][b]release.revision.txt[/b][/i] file and edit the number to [i][b]11460[/b][/i]
 - Validate local files through Steam and check to see if the language is set to English.

notes.title: Changes regarding trading restrictions, bot policy
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors!

We’ve been listening to your recent feedback regarding trading restrictions and bot presence in Tree of Savior, and would like to announce some changes we’ll be making to improve your in-game experience.


[b]1) Less Trade Restrictions[/b]

As mentioned in previous announcements, the trade restrictions were implemented to address RMT issues. However, based on your feedback, we have determined that it may feel a bit too high-handed. 

As such we have decided to implement new measures to reduce the inconvenience of trading restrictions on non-Token users in order to reduce trading restrictions on regular users.

We are planning on allowing Non-Token users to partake in 1:1 trading. However, we are not yet certain how we will implement this new system. More details will be released as soon as they have been decided upon.

The changes are intended to remove restrictions to players who may not be Token users but wish to help out or give class restricted items to other players. We also hope this will dissuade bots from collecting items through farming.


[b]2) Bot Report Function[/b]

We wish to continuously strive towards reducing the bot problem and provide better gaming experiences for normal players.

As such, we are working on implementing the much requested bot report function. Not only that but we’re also developing and testing a system to detect bots faster. 

Through the reporting system, you will not only able to select and report suspected bots, but you will also be able to report items in the market suspected of being part of RMT (e.g. low-value items sold at unusually high prices). Through this system, GMs will be able to catch more bots by prioritizing and reviewing cases reported by users.

However, we know that this system can be misused or even abused and are in the process of polishing rules to regulate the system. We wish to provide merits to those who accurately report bots, and penalize those who misuse the system to report innocent users. This will most likely be a constantly updated set of rules since there will always be different cases.


As always, we thank you for your continued support, understanding, and enthusiasm for Tree of Savior.  

Sincerely,
IMC Staff

notes.title: Known Issues [UPDATED - April 12th]
notes.content:
Greetings, Saviors.

We are aware of the problems some of you are experiencing while trying to log into the game. For the following known issues, please try the solutions we suggest. Head to our official forums for the xml files in question. 

Link to post in official forums : https://forum.treeofsavior.com/t/known-issues-march-29th/157442

[b]1. Server List Not Showing on Log-In Screen[/b]

Please download the files from the official forums and copy and paste them to the following directories.

client.xml -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release

updater.config.xml  -> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch

updater.config_en.xml 
-> Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release/patch


[b]2. $No Data$ texts in-game[/b]

For players that see $No Data$ texts in-game instead of normal text, please try the following.

a) Go to Steam/steamapps/common/TreeOfSavior/release
b) Open release.revision.txt
c) Erase the number that is typed in the file
d) Save the file and close it
e) Restart the game

[b]3. Unable to advance in class[/b]

We are aware that some of you are experiencing problems when trying to advance in class. The dev team is looking into it and an announcement will be made when this issue is resolved.

[b]4. Controller issues[/b]
Playstation 3, Playstation 4 and Xbox 360 controllers should be working correctly. However, we are aware that Xbox One controllers may have issues and are working on a fix. Please note that having controllers plugged in may conflict with mouse input .

[b]Possible fix for Xbox One Controllers[/b] : Replacing the Xinput driver from the KB3140743 update with a previous version of the driver should fix the problem. (Thank you to the user that brought this to our attention)

[b]5. Server bottleneck issues[/b]
The server bottleneck problem seems to be much worse than expected. We are currently looking into several options to mitigate the problem, including creating a new server. We have not yet reached a final decision on the details and will let you know as soon as possible.

[b]6. Spamming on chat[/b]
You will be able to reset the chat and get rid of spamming of messages in chat by restarting your client. Please let us know if the problems persists after restarting the client. We are looking at ways to reduce spam and will make an announcement when it is implemented.

[b]7. QUEST : To Gateway to the Great King[/b]
We are aware that there are issues with this quest and are working on a solution. Apologies for the inconvenience that this is causing. In the meantime, we recommend trying to go to Orsha and completing quests in that area for those players that find no other quests for that level.

[b]8. Launcher closes without client properly appearing[/b]
There seems to be a problem with the launcher vanishing without properly launching the client even after validating / re-installing / replacing XML files. The dev team is looking into this matter, but in the meantime, adding "Client_tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release" and "tos.exe" in "Steam\steamapps\common\TreeOfSavior\release\patch" to the exception list of any Anti-virus programs may help.

[b]9. QUEST :  Obversion / Drowsy Scent[/b]
We are aware that these quests currently have people stumped. We will be working on a more permanent fix. Please stay tuned for an update regarding these quests. In the meantime, we would recommend trying other zones / questlines.

Unfinished Commision should now work properly. However, please let us know via the ticket system if you are still having trouble with this particular quest.

[b]10. Instance disconnect problems / Malfunctioning elevators & cable cars[/b]

[b]11. Disabling Shout Chat on top of the screen[/b]
We are working on a more permanent fix, but at the moment you may disable the banners at the top of your screen to avoid spam by unwanted individuals. Please go to the small gear icon next to your chat window and uncheck the 'Show Shouts on Top' function to disable shout chat.

This error may occur if you attempt to run the game directly from the desktop. We recommend that you log onto the Steam client and run the game from your library.

This item gives you 1 stat point upon use. There's a bug where if you use it while in a dungeon, the item gets consumed, but you don't receive your stat point. We're going to look into this issue and find a way to compensate those who did not get their stat point from this item.

 - Open the [i][b]release.revision.txt[/b][/i] file and edit the number to [i][b]11460[/b][/i]
 - Validate local files through Steam and check to see if the language is set to English.

Sincerely,
IMC Staff
